repairing-plug.seo_p1: The repair plug (Repairing Plug) is a solid PP-R pin which, in combination with the special welding tool, repairs drill hole emergencies.
repairing-plug.seo_p2: It is made of the identical material as the K Aqua pipe system and fuses to an absolutely homogeneous mass when inserted into the damaged pipe.
repairing-plug.seo_p3: Instead of opening up walls over a large area to replace pipe sections, the hole is simply welded; the repaired spot is then just as pressure-resistant as the original pipe.

faq.q: What material is the repair plug made of?
faq.a: It consists of 100% high-quality Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R) Type 3, exactly like our K Aqua pipe systems.

faq.q: Must the plug be cut off after welding?
faq.a: Yes, after the welding spot has cooled down completely, the protruding end of the plug is cut off flush with the pipe wall.

faq.q: Can I use the plug when the pipe network is filled?
faq.a: No, the water must be completely turned off on the affected line and the pipe must be dry in the area of the drill hole.

__solutions.lead: Why polypropylene is the right material for tomorrow's water supply, ecologically, technically, and economically.

benefits.d: Polypropylene originates from gases that were previously incinerated without purpose, drastically reducing air pollution. Production utilizes water in a closed cooling loop, protecting rivers, streams, and lakes.
PP carries recycling code "5" and can be separated by material type. We recycle all production waste and offcuts, amidst high demand for PP recyclate.
As an engineering plastic, PP is remarkably resistant to solvents, alkalis, and acids, molding complex geometries via injection molding at low costs and high volumes.
PP products last significantly longer than comparable materials: easy to maintain, wear-resistant, and resilient against aging and temperature extremes.

textSection.title: The Engineering Art Behind Silence
textSection.p1: In skyscrapers and expansive resort complexes, extreme physical conditions prevail. Water pressure pumped hundreds of meters high. Temperature differences that push traditional materials to their limits.
textSection.p2: Traditional copper systems show significant erosion effects at high flow velocities. Cavitation caused by pressure fluctuations in skyscraper risers inevitably leads to microcracks, pitting, and ultimately catastrophic water damage that can paralyze entire floors. For a hotel operator, this means not only massive restoration costs, but an irreparable loss of reputation.
textSection.p3: K-Aqua takes a radically different path.
textSection.p4: Our systems are based on latest-generation Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R). Through a highly complex extrusion process in our German headquarters, we align the polymer chains to exhibit an unprecedented combination of flexibility and extreme pressure resistance. When pressure surges (water hammer) occur, the material elastically absorbs this kinetic energy rather than passing it as an acoustic shock or mechanical crack into the building structure.
textSection.h3: Homogeneous Welded Joints: The End of Leaks
textSection.p5: The weakest link in any piping system is the connection. Threads corrode, sealing rings become porous, glued joints fatigue through thermal cycling.
textSection.p6: We use the principle of molecular fusion. Pipe and fitting are thermally heated to exactly 260°C and then joined. Within fractions of a second, the polymer chains of both components merge into an inseparable, monolithic unit. The result: there is no 'connection' anymore. Pipe and fitting are a single, continuous piece of material. Without seals, without weak points, with 100% reliability.

items.title: 1. Legionella Prevention at Molecular Level

items.p1: Every decibel counts. In luxury resorts, flushing or showering in adjacent suites must not be audible.

items.title: 3. High-Pressure Resilience in Skyscrapers
items.p1: Hotels with 80, 100, or 120 floors place extreme demands on risers. Hydrostatic pressure in lower sections of the building is enormous.
items.p2: K-Aqua offers special pressure ratings (SDR 6 / PN 20) combined with fiber reinforcement, guaranteeing a service life of over 50 years under continuous load even at temperatures of 70°C. We conquer gravity.

items.title: 4. Thermal Management & District Cooling
items.p1: In desert regions like Dubai or Riyadh, cooling is the most expensive commodity. District cooling systems transport chilled water over long distances to the resort.
items.p2: The excellent insulation values of PP-R prevent condensation and massively minimize cooling loss. No more rusted chiller pipes, no dripping ceilings. Just pure, unadulterated efficiency.
